identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparative Study About Effect of Rituximab Versus IL-6 Inhibitor in Induction of Remission in Active ILD in Scleroderma Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: All SSc patients should know if they have been diagnosed with interstitial lung disease, or pulmonary hypertension and keep results from his/her last pulmonary function test, chest imaging, echocardiogram and stress test
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: All SSc patients should know if they have been diagnosed with interstitial lung disease, or pulmonary hypertension and keep results from his/her last pulmonary function test, chest imaging, echocardiogram and stress test Diffuse infiltrative lung disease (ILD): progressive shortness of breath is the most frequently presentation going to ER pulmonary unit first. It should be considered in case of persistent dry cough or dyspnea, which should be looked for in any patient with SSc. an etiological assessment must be conducted in order not to mistakenly attribute ILD to the SSc.

armGroups.label: Rituxmab
armGroups.description: 1000 mg Rituxmab IV infusion at 1st day then after 15 weeks then after 6 months for 1 year

armGroups.label: IL-6 inhibitor
armGroups.description: 6 mg/kg IV infusion every month not exceed 600 mg for 1 year
